**Intervention Design:**
Install a **real-time erosion monitoring system** on the leading edge of each composite blade, using **acoustic emission sensors** spaced at **1.5 m intervals** along the erosion-prone region (first 30% of blade length from root). The system will classify erosion severity in **four discrete states** (0: no erosion, 1: minor surface roughness, 2: moderate material loss, 3: severe structural compromise) via a **machine learning model trained on acoustic signatures** of known erosion stages. The model will trigger **automated alerts** during scheduled service windows when erosion reaches state ≥2, enabling targeted **protective coating application** or **localized repair patches** without full blade replacement.

**Concrete Parameters:**
PARAMETER: Sensor type — Acoustic emission sensors (piezoelectric, 100 kHz–1 MHz frequency range) — ASSUMPTION (value not stated in the cited record)
PARAMETER: Sensor spacing — 1.5 m along leading edge (first 30% blade length) — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Erosion classification states — 4 discrete states (0–3) — EVIDENCE-BACKED [doi:10.2172/2517922]
PARAMETER: Alert threshold — State ≥2 triggers repair alert — EVIDENCE-BACKED [doi:10.21683/1729-2646-2022-22-1-13-19]
PARAMETER: Repair window — Scheduled service intervals (every 12 months) — ASSUMPTION (value not stated in the cited record)
PARAMETER: Coating/repair method — Localized epoxy-based protective patches or polyurethane coatings — ASSUMPTION

**Expected Measurable Effect:**
- **Energy recovery:** Restores **4–6% annual energy production** by preventing erosion-induced performance degradation (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record).
- **Maintenance cost reduction:** Eliminates **unplanned repairs** by enabling **predictive, scheduled interventions** (EVIDENCE-BACKED [doi:10.21683/1729-2646-2022-22-1-13-19]).
- **Blade lifespan extension:** Delays full replacement by **2–3 years** via targeted local repairs (ASSUMPTION).

**Constraint Compliance:**
- **No blade geometry redesign:** Sensors are **embedded externally** (no structural modification) and repairs use **localized patches** (C1, C2).
- **Repairs only at scheduled windows:** System triggers alerts **only during service intervals** (C3).
- **Device compatibility:** Designed for **4 MW, 150 m rotor onshore turbines** with **composite blades** (C4).

**Falsification Test:**
Test protocol: Deploy **12 acoustic emission sensors** (6 per blade) on **two turbines** in a **high-erosion region** (e.g., coastal site with ≥150 mm annual precipitation). Operate for **18 months** (covering two service windows). **Pass criteria:** ≥80% of alerts for erosion state ≥2 must correlate with **visual inspection findings** (manual measurement of leading-edge thickness loss via laser scanner, tolerance ±0.5 mm). **Fail criteria:** <70% correlation or ≥3 false positives/negatives per blade.
